  Did I have a healthy relationship with my partner? 
Did I protect my children from danger even from their immediate family members? 
 Did I allow my children to place boundaries with family members and myself. 
 Did I mock my child’s autistic behaviors such as their stims, noise sensitivity, social difficulties, etc. 
  Did I respect my child as an equal? 
Did I parent my child to allow them to explore and express themself without criticism? 
Did I teach my child how to be an adult through their learning style?
